user.title: Sector Alarm
user.description: Enter your My Pages credentials and the Panel ID for the site you want to control. You can find the Panel ID in the URL after logging in to mypages.sectoralarm.net (e.g. `#!/systems/01234567`).

data_description.pin: Required for arm/disarm and locks. Leave blank if you only want read-only sensors.

reauth_confirm.title: Sector Alarm — re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: Your saved credentials for {email} were rejected. Enter the current password (and PIN if it changed).

reconfigure.title: Sector Alarm — edit settings
reconfigure.description: Update credentials or PIN for panel {panel_id}. Leave PIN blank to be prompted in the UI on every arm/disarm.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Sector Alarm. Check your network and try again.
